description: [github] Find public GitHub repositories matching a query. Use this when you don't know the exact repo; use github_repo when you already have owner and name. Supports GitHub qualifiers like 'mcp language:rust stars:>100'. Returns up to `limit` repos (full_name, description, stars, language, url, updated_at). Unauthenticated calls share a low rate limit.

query.description: Search text with optional GitHub qualifiers, e.g. 'mcp server language:typescript'

sort.description: Sort order: most stars, most recently updated, or most forks

name: github_search_repos
title: GitHub: search_repos
